convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iRSI indicator with simple crossover entry/exit rules, fixed lot sizing, and no external .mqh dependencies for trading logic

other_exits: Close long on RSI crossing below overbought level; close short on RSI crossing above oversold level

custom_logic_notes: EA uses standard RSI overbought/oversold crossover strategy. RSI crossing above oversold level triggers long entry; RSI crossing below overbought level triggers short entry. Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one. Digit adjustment applied: SL/TP values multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to normalize pip values across 4-digit and 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use pandas-ta or ta-lib for RSI calculation. Entry signals on completed bar RSI values (shift=1 for previous bar, shift=2 for bar before). SL/TP in pips need digit adjustment logic: multiply by 10 for 5-digit symbols. Position check before entry using MT5 position enumeration. New bar detection via bar time comparison. FOK filling mode for market orders.
